items.title: Volkswagen launches China-supplied cars in Uzbekistan, eyes growth markets expansion
items.summary: Volkswagen has officially launched its Volkswagen and Jetta brands in Uzbekistan, a significant move marking its first export market managed entirely through its China operations.

items.title: Porsche's promised comeback does little to calm investors over China
items.summary: Porsche's new CEO, Michael Leiters, has urged shareholders for patience, promising a detailed turnaround plan by October 7. Investors are demanding urgent action following a significant profit margin slump and declining sales in China.

items.title: Tata Motors PV targets ₹6 lakh crore revenue, 1.2 million PV sales by FY31
items.summary: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles is projecting revenues exceeding ₹6 lakh crore by FY31, aiming for 1.2 million unit sales driven by EVs and CNG models.

items.title: Porsche CEO sticks to targets as he navigates road to recovery
items.summary: Porsche is sticking to its financial targets despite weak margins and growing pressure from key markets like China and the US. CEO Michael Leiters is expected to acknowledge near-term challenges, including tariffs and competition, while confirming the 2026 outlook and outlining a recovery plan due in October.

items.summary: This move targets the delivery and logistics sector. The company has secured necessary certifications for batteries and vehicles. Initial trials will occur within Reliance's own fleet.

items.summary: Bharat Seats Ltd. is moving to significantly expand its business with Suzuki Motorcycle India Pvt.

items.title: Brembo, Ningbo SAFE Form Joint Venture To Manufacture Motorcycle ABS Systems In India
items.summary: Brembo and China's Ningbo SAFE Brakes Systems have signed a joint venture agreement to establish a new company, BRSF Active Safety Solutions, focused on the production of anti-lock braking systems (ABS) for motorcycles in India. The venture aims to address growing demand for advanced braking technologies in the country's two-wheeler market, which accounts for up to 25 million registered vehicles annually.

items.title: UltraTech deploys 45 e-trucks for clinker transportation in northern India
items.summary: The initiative is expected to reduce more than 8,900 tonnes of CO2 emissions annually and displace around 2.9 million litres of diesel consumption each year.

items.title: Ferrari names new marketing chief after Luce EV debut
items.summary: Ferrari has appointed Massimiliano Di Silvestre, formerly of BMW Italy, as its new chief marketing and commercial officer, replacing Enrico Galliera after 16 years. Di Silvestre, with over two decades of automotive experience, will join Ferrari's leadership team on July 1.

items.title: Tata Motors, TPEM sign MoU with UCO Bank to offer inventory funding for passenger vehicle dealers
items.summary: The partnership aims to help dealers manage working capital more efficiently through an inventory funding programme covering both ICE and electric vehicles.

items.title: Tata Motors to invest up to ₹40,000 crore by FY31
items.summary: The company targets a 20% domestic market share by FY31, with electric and CNG vehicles driving significant growth. This ambitious plan includes expanding its EV lineup and enhancing battery technology to address adoption barriers, positioning Tata Motors for a multi-powertrain future.

items.title: Tata Motors, Mahindra grab top two spots in ICCT's Global Automaker Ranking 2025 for EV energy efficiency
items.summary: The report says stronger regulations and faster EV adoption could help India reduce oil imports, improve energy security and boost domestic manufacturing.

items.title: BMW launches X6 M60i xDrive at ₹1.77 crore with 530 hp mild-hybrid V8
items.summary: Imported as a CBU, the flagship Sports Activity Coupé combines a 530 hp V8 mild-hybrid powertrain, M performance, ADAS and connected-car technologies.

items.title: Tesla to ramp up production in Germany by 20%
items.summary: Tesla's Berlin plant is set to boost weekly vehicle production by 20% to 7,500 units from October, necessitating the hiring of 1,000 new employees. This follows earlier announcements of capacity expansion and increased investment in battery cell manufacturing.

items.title: Force Motors Assembles 200,000th Mercedes-Benz Engine at Chakan Manufacturing Facility
items.summary: Force Motors Limited has completed the assembly of its 200,000th engine for Mercedes-Benz India at its dedicated powertrain manufacturing facility in Chakan, Pune. The milestone unit, a six-cylinder M256 engine, was allocated for installation into a Mercedes-Benz GLS 450 luxury SUV.

items.title: PLI, duty incentives soon for lithium, nickel processing units in India
items.summary: This strategic move aims to reduce reliance on overseas processors and bolster the nation's critical minerals ecosystem. The initiative supports the National Critical Minerals Mission and aligns with projected growth in demand for electric vehicle batteries.

items.title: India readies ₹12,000 crore push for local battery component manufacturing
items.summary: India is set to launch a new incentive scheme to boost local manufacturing of advanced cell battery components. This initiative aims to reduce import dependence for crucial materials like cathode and anode active materials, electrolysers, and copper foil separators.

items.title: Heavy Industries Ministry Extends Global Tender Deadline for Rare Earth Magnet Manufacturing Scheme
items.summary: The Ministry of Heavy Industries has extended the bid submission timeline for its global tender under the Scheme to Promote Manufacturing of Sintered Rare Earth Permanent Magnet. Following requests from multiple industry stakeholders, the bid due date has been moved from June 29 to July 29, 2026.

items.title: Battery PLI scheme stumbles as no penalties realised, beneficiaries now want extension
items.summary: The Ministry of Heavy Industries has been issuing quarterly penalty notices to defaulting companies which have missed capacity installation deadlines, but not a single rupee has been realised so far.

items.title: BS-7 and CAFÉ-II: How regulatory norms are reshaping a high-value growth cycle for India’s auto component manufacturers
items.summary: While regulations are evolving, the focus is on higher technology intensity and platform consolidation. This transition is positioning India as a global export hub for emission-compliant technologies, promising margin-led growth in a multi-powertrain era.
